allowed_view: For every aligned FASTA character, reveal and persist only canonical-valid versus noncanonical/missing: A/C/G/T -> 1; gap, N and IUPAC ambiguity -> 0. Nucleotide identity must not persist.
valid_sequence_pair: comparable canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
valid_edge: at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair exists between the two frozen graph endpoint localities
species_admissible: every edge in that species' unchanged frozen density-scaled graph is valid
failed_species_policy: drop the species from the relational genetic estimand; never rewire its graph, change marker, delete individual sequences, or relax the comparable-site threshold

post_mask_relational_support.target_supported: target has at least 5 surviving geographically supported source species under the already frozen host-resource pair-support graph
post_mask_relational_support.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_CHARACTER_MASK_GEOMETRY; do not open nucleotide identity or T_st

required_requalification: If structural minima pass, rerun the exact relational_host_resource_qualification_rule_v0.1 estimator, world generator, seed namespace, cell definitions, alpha and Wilson gates on the exact survivor dyad design. No retuning is authorized.
